# Shmoop

> Shmoop is a comprehensive educational platform offering free study guides, learning resources, and analysis across literature, science, math, history, and the humanities.

Shmoop provides accessible educational content for students and teachers, featuring detailed study guides on classic literature (including Shakespeare), STEM subjects, US history, and cultural texts. The platform combines traditional academic resources with video analysis and modern teaching approaches to help students understand complex subjects.

## Key Topics

- Study Guides
- Literature Analysis
- Shakespeare
- Classic Literature
- Poetry
- AP Test Prep
- Educational Videos
- Teacher Resources
- Book Summaries
- Grammar
- US History
- Biology
- Math
- Historical Texts
- Literary Theory

## Core Learning Resources

- [Learning Guides](https://www.shmoop.com/study-guides): Free study guides across literature, math, science, and social studies.
- [Literature Learning Guides & Teacher Resources](https://www.shmoop.com/literature): Free student and teacher guides to literature by classic authors.
- [Shakespeare Plays and Sonnets](https://www.shmoop.com/shakespeare): Shakespeare plays, sonnets, analysis, and modern English translation.
- [Poetry](https://www.shmoop.com/poetry): Poetry study guides and analysis by Dickinson, Blake, and other poets.
- [Video Analysis from Shmoop](https://www.shmoop.com/video): Educational videos on literature, math, history, science, and finance.

## Science & Mathematics

- [Math](https://www.shmoop.com/math): Math resources including algebra, calculus, and AP test prep.
- [Biology Learning Guides & Teacher Resources](https://www.shmoop.com/biology): Biology guides covering DNA, photosynthesis, evolution, and cells.

## History & Social Studies

- [US History, American History](https://www.shmoop.com/history): US History study guides covering American Revolution, Civil War, Cold War.
- [Historical Texts](https://www.shmoop.com/study-guides/historical-texts): Historical texts, speeches, and documents analyzed with context.
- [Biography](https://www.shmoop.com/biography): Biographies of authors, leaders, and innovators from history.

## Literary & Cultural Analysis

- [Shmoop Online Bible Guide](https://www.shmoop.com/bible): Bible study guides analyzing Old and New Testaments as literature.
- [Literary Theory, Movements, and Critics](https://www.shmoop.com/literary-criticism): Literary theory, movements, and critics explained in accessible language.
- [Music](https://www.shmoop.com/music): Music study guides and song analysis for artists and bands.

## Writing & Language

- [Grammar](https://www.shmoop.com/grammar): Grammar guide covering parts of speech, punctuation, and syntax.

## Reference Tools

- [Famous Quotes](https://www.shmoop.com/quotes): Database of famous quotes from literature, movies, history, and music.
